images.caption: Straw work at the market
images.alt: A Bahamian straw market stall close up, with woven baskets, a wide straw sun hat and a coiled mat decorated with pink and orange raffia flowers, the sea behind.

images.caption: The cover
images.alt: The cover of All Things Bahamian: Upper Elementary — four Bahamian children with binoculars, an open map, a notebook and a cup of coloured pencils, in front of turquoise water, small cays, a lighthouse and a flamingo.

images.caption: Map of The Bahamas
images.alt: A colouring page: an outline map of the whole Bahamian archipelago with every island and cay named, from Grand Bahama and Abaco down to Inagua, with a north arrow and a scale bar.

images.caption: The cover
images.alt: The cover of All Things Bahamian: My First Cultural Coloring Book — three young Bahamian children at a beach table holding crayons and showing a half-finished colouring page, with a flamingo, a sailing boat and pastel harbour houses behind them.

images.caption: A reading corner
images.alt: A sunlit reading corner: a low wooden shelf of picture books, a round straw mat, a tipped-over straw basket spilling coloured crayons, and an open colouring book showing a part-coloured flamingo and an outlined hibiscus. A shuttered window looks out to a palm, pale sand and turquoise sea.

images.caption: Mr. Hooker tells the legend
images.alt: An older fisherman in a straw hat and faded blue floral shirt sits on the edge of a weathered wooden dock at sunset, one hand raised mid-story. Beside him a coil of rope, a folded green net and a battered tackle box; a small boat is tied below. Green volcanic mountains and a low golden sun behind.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: Flags over the regatta
images.alt: Rows of plain coloured bunting strung above a grassy waterfront at a Bahamian regatta. Three wooden sloops with tall masts and white sails race on turquoise water beyond. Coral-pink and yellow vendor stalls stacked with pineapples, coconuts and papaya, a crowd in straw hats watching from the grass.

images.caption: The fruits of The Bahamas
images.alt: A roadside fruit stall under a faded blue awning: sapodillas, guavas halved to show pink flesh, knobbly green sugar apples, a bunch of small bananas, tamarind pods in a shallow basket and two halved papayas. A straw basket at one end, pink and yellow wooden houses, a coconut palm and turquoise sea behind.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: Cape Santa Maria
images.alt: A long curve of pale sand at Cape Santa Maria, Long Island, with water grading from clear turquoise shallows to deep blue. Sea grape bushes along the dune, three coconut palms leaning in the wind, a weathered wooden dinghy pulled up on the sand and conch shells at the tideline in late afternoon light.

images.caption: Hawaii’s Book of Legends
images.alt: A thick old leather-bound book lying open on a flat sun-bleached rock at the edge of a shallow coral reef, its weathered cream pages blank. A conch shell and a sprig of dried seaweed beside it, clear turquoise water over coral and two small yellow fish below, and green volcanic mountains across the bay in late golden light.

images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: The comet strikes Cosmic
images.alt: A vast humpback whale rising through deep night ocean water, her long pectoral fins glowing cosmic purple and scattered with starlight. A white-gold comet streaks down towards her raised back. Turtles, rays and shoals of small fish look up from the water below her, safe in her shadow, under a sky full of stars.

images.book: Going To The Regatta Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: Pink sand at Deals Beach
images.alt: The pink sand at Deals Beach, Long Island, with clear calm shallow water washing quietly up over it.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: Friday soup at Green Leaf
images.alt: A deep white enamel bowl of thick Bahamian soup with chunks of root vegetable, a wedge of lime on the rim, beside a fresh green coconut cut open with a straw in it, a folded paper napkin with a spoon resting on it, and a scattering of pigeon peas on a worn wooden table. Behind, the open serving window of a mint green and coral building with bougainvillea against the wall.

images.caption: Anna’s dance at sunset
images.alt: Anna, a Black girl of about thirteen with chocolate-brown skin and long black hair, dances barefoot on wet sand at the edge of the sea at sunset, arms thrown wide and head tipped back mid-spin, her reflection in the thin sheet of water beneath her. She wears a knee-length floral sundress and a white shell necklace. The low orange sun, green volcanic mountains and two seabirds are behind her.

images.caption: The Glass Window Bridge, Eleuthera
images.alt: The Glass Window Bridge in Eleuthera: a road bridge crossing a narrow gap in the rock, with the rough navy Atlantic breaking beyond it and the calm clear turquoise Bight of Eleuthera in the foreground on the near side.

images.caption: The Queen’s Staircase, Nassau
images.alt: The Queen’s Staircase in Nassau: a long flight of worn limestone steps cut down through a narrow gorge, with tall pale stone walls draped in ferns and vines either side and dappled sunlight falling across the steps.

images.caption: Designing the Cosmic Finback
images.alt: An illustrator’s worktable seen from above, scattered with pencil sketches of a humpback whale — a tail fluke, a long pectoral fin, a whole whale in outline. On one sheet a fin has been coloured deep purple and scattered with starlight. A purple and a graphite pencil, a sharpener with shavings, an eraser, a jar of coloured pencils and a conch shell lie around them.
images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book

images.caption: The flag of The Bahamas
images.alt: The flag of The Bahamas lifting in a light breeze from a white pole — three bands of aquamarine, gold and aquamarine with a black triangle at the hoist — above a calm clear turquoise sea and a pale sand beach, with palm fronds swaying.

images.caption: Eleuthera Sugar Loaf pineapples
images.alt: Sugar Loaf pineapples growing in red-brown earth in Eleuthera, one whole and one cut in half, their leaves swaying gently with a leaf or two drifting down, and a calm flat band of turquoise sea on the horizon.

images.caption: The vendor stalls at Salt Pond
images.alt: A row of small wooden vendor stalls at the Long Island regatta grounds at Salt Pond, painted pink, turquoise, yellow and lime green, with bunting lifting between their roofs and people walking between them. Sloops sit under sail on calm glassy turquoise water behind.
images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure

images.caption: Regatta I-Spy
images.alt: Looking down into clear shallow turquoise water over rippled sand: conch and scallop shells, orange starfish and small striped fish mid-dart, with the hulls of three small sloops on the moving surface above and light flickering in bands across the sand.
images.book: Going To The Regatta Coloring and Activity Book

images.caption: Design a regatta flag
images.alt: A wooden table at the regatta set up for designing flags — blank pennants, coloured pencils, scissors and string, one pennant lifting at the corner — with bunting rippling between two poles and a gentle swell running up the sand beyond, a sloop leaving a soft wake.
images.book: Going To The Regatta Coloring and Activity Book

images.caption: Working out the colouring tips
images.alt: A worktable seen from above with practice patches of pencil shading — light, medium, pressed dark and a blend — beside a line drawing of a flamingo half coloured in. A jar of coloured pencils, loose pencils, a sharpener with shavings and an eraser around them, and a leafy plant stirring by the window.

images.caption: Sunrise over the Atlantic
images.alt: Sunrise over the Atlantic from the rocky Long Island shore: the sun just clear of the horizon, the sky banded apricot and gold, a low swell rolling in and small waves running up the pale sand in a thin lace of foam. Dark ironshore rock in front, casuarinas leaning, two seabirds on the wing.
images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure

images.caption: Coral Reef I-Spy
images.alt: A bright coral reef underwater: shells, orange starfish, small striped fish, two crabs among the rocks and two green sea turtles gliding, with a small leather-bound book resting half hidden on the sand. Sunlight flickers down in slow shifting bands.
images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book

images.caption: Cosmic bookmarks
images.alt: Four finished paper bookmarks laid out on a pale wooden desk, decorated by hand with a whale tail, a starry night sky, a pattern of small waves and a ribbon of starlight, with scissors, a ball of twine and a jar of coloured pencils beside them.
images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book

images.caption: The queen conch
images.alt: A live queen conch resting on pale rippled sand in clear shallow turquoise water, seen looking down into the shell's opening. The broad flared lip is spread wide and glossy deep pink, and the animal is nestled inside it: a dark claw-shaped operculum, a mottled olive-brown speckled foot, and at the front a short blunt snout with two golden eyes on short stalks looking out. Sea grass sways and sunlight flickers in slow bands across the sand.

images.caption: Junkanoo on Bay Street
images.alt: A Junkanoo rush on Bay Street in Nassau at night: a lead dancer mid-stride in an enormous fanned headdress of pink, orange and turquoise crepe, with drummers, cowbell shakers and horn players behind and a crowd along the balconied buildings under lit street lamps.

images.caption: Nature Pool Observer
images.alt: A clear natural rock pool on the Long Island shore, with pale sand and stones on the bottom, a few tiny fish, a small crab and green weed moving slowly. Fine ripple rings spread across the surface. An open blank notebook with a pencil and a magnifying glass rest on the rock at the near edge.
images.book: Going To The Regatta Coloring and Activity Book

images.caption: Carried on the glowing fin
images.alt: Anna, a Pacific-island girl of about thirteen with deep chocolate-brown skin and long loose jet-black hair in a hibiscus-print sundress, standing with her arms flung wide on the long outstretched fin of an enormous humpback whale, the fin glowing cosmic purple and scattered with starlight, high above dark mountains, a pale beach, the lit windows of houses and the sea.

images.caption: The light from the window
images.alt: Two island women seen from behind at an open window at night, a mother and her older mother, looking out at a strange purple glow spreading over the dark sea and hills, with a lamp, a jug of red juice and a woven mat in the warm room behind them.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: The drive home after midnight
images.alt: A car driving home late at night on a narrow Long Island road, its headlights lighting the empty road ahead, which is lined with low scrub and leaning palms, enormous field of stars.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: Rainbow over the Atlantic
images.alt: A full bright rainbow arching over the Atlantic from the Long Island shore as a shower clears, half the sky still soft grey and half opening to blue, with a low swell rolling in and small waves running up pale sand in a thin lace of foam.

images.caption: A Bahamian lighthouse
images.alt: A Bahamian lighthouse on a low rocky point, a tall slender tower in broad red and white bands with a glass lantern room at the top and a small keeper's cottage beside it, pale limestone running down to clear turquoise shallows. A low swell rolls in and small waves break gently over the rocks in a thin lace of foam and slide back, with ripple lines travelling across the shallows.

images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: Design Anna’s Celebration Dress
images.alt: A worktable seen from above with four sheets of cream paper, each carrying a hand-drawn dress design coloured differently — one patterned with hibiscus flowers, one with small shells around the hem, one with a sweep of stars, one left as a plain outline — with a jar of coloured pencils, loose pencils, scraps of bright fabric and ribbon and a dish of shells around them. Through a window behind, calm turquoise sea moves gently under palms.

images.book: Going To The Regatta Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: Decorate the C1 Mainsail
images.alt: A Bahamian C1 racing sloop sailing on clear turquoise water, its single enormous triangular mainsail decorated with bold hand-drawn stripes, zigzags, stars and shells in aquamarine, gold and coral, two crew sitting out on the pry board, a low swell rolling under the hull and light shifting in bands through the shallows.

images.book: Going To The Regatta Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: Plan an Island Meal
images.alt: A Bahamian family meal laid out on a wooden table outdoors, seen from above: a whole fried fish, peas and rice, baked chicken, fried plantains, potato salad, a halved coconut and a jug of juice with cut limes, with enamel plates, forks and hibiscus flowers between the dishes under dappled afternoon light.

images.caption: An island settlement
images.alt: A small Bahamian island settlement around a quiet harbour: pastel clapboard houses in pink, mint, yellow and pale blue stepping down a low hill, a wooden dock running out into clear turquoise water with two small boats alongside and a sailing boat moored beyond, palms and sea grape between the houses and a church spire on the rise. Ripple lines travel across the shallows and light flickers in bands over the sand below.

images.caption: The classroom display wall
images.alt: A primary classroom noticeboard with about twelve sheets of cream paper pinned up, each a child's coloured-in drawing of a Bahamian subject — a conch, a flamingo, a sailing boat, a pineapple, a lighthouse, a Junkanoo headdress, a fish, a palm — all in bright uneven crayon and pencil. Below the board a low shelf holds a jar of crayons, a stack of paper and a small potted plant.

images.caption: Under the stars
images.alt: Anna, a girl of about thirteen with chocolate-brown skin and long black hair, sitting close on the sand at night between her mother and her grandmother, all three seen from behind and looking up at a sky full of stars, one arm around her shoulders. Beyond them the dark sea moves gently, small waves running up the sand in a thin lace of pale foam, with green mountains behind.

images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: Inking the line art
images.alt: A colouring page being inked at an illustrator's desk, seen from above: a sheet of cream paper carrying a clean black line drawing of a humpback whale breaching over water, outlines only and completely uncoloured, with a fine black pen laid across one corner, a pencil, an eraser and a jar of pens beside it, and the edge of a rougher pencil sketch of the same whale showing underneath.

images.book: The Girl and The Whale Coloring and Activity Book
images.caption: Colour tests for Cosmic
images.alt: Colour tests on an illustrator's desk: a sheet of cream paper with two rows of painted swatches working through deep violet, indigo, lilac and blue-purple, beside a pencil sketch of a whale's long pectoral fin with three versions coloured in different purples to compare, one scattered with tiny stars, with a brush, a jar of water, a palette and coloured pencils around them.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: Stella Maris at dawn
images.alt: Three Bahamian sisters walking barefoot together along the shore at Stella Maris, Long Island, early in the morning, seen from behind at a little distance, one carrying her sandals. The sky is soft apricot and pale gold just after sunrise. A low swell rolls in and small waves run up the wet sand in a thin lace of foam around their feet, with ironshore rock and casuarinas at the edge.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: The last night of the regatta
images.alt: The last night of a Bahamian regatta at Salt Pond: a lit stage with a band playing, people of all ages dancing on the grass in front of it, families watching from folding chairs, strings of lights between poles and food and craft stalls glowing at the side, with the dark harbour and moored boats beyond.

images.book: Going To The Regatta: Nicholas’ Long Island Family Adventure
images.caption: Lunch and a fresh coconut
images.alt: A table outside a small Bahamian restaurant at lunchtime: a bowl of soup with a spoon on a folded napkin, a plate of bread, and a fresh green coconut opened at the top with a straw in it, beads of water on its skin, with more coconuts in a basket, painted shutters and bougainvillea behind.

images.caption: Proud to be Bahamian
images.alt: Nine Bahamian children of mixed ages standing together on a beach, all waving and smiling, two of them holding Bahamian flags lifting in the breeze. Palms lean behind them and clear turquoise sea beyond, where a low swell rolls in and small waves run up the pale sand in a thin lace of foam.

images.caption: Designing a Junkanoo costume
images.alt: A table where a Junkanoo costume is being designed and built, seen from above: sheets of cream paper with hand-drawn costume designs coloured in bright crepe-paper colours, a part-built cardboard headdress base with strips of pink, orange and turquoise crepe paper being pasted on, a pot of paste with a brush, scissors, string and loose fringing.

images.caption: An old stone fort
images.alt: An old colonial stone fort on a rise above a Bahamian harbour: thick pale limestone walls with a rounded bastion, narrow slit windows, worn steps climbing to the top and two old iron cannons on wooden carriages pointing out over the water. Ferns and bougainvillea grow from gaps in the stonework. Below, clear turquoise water where a low swell rolls in and light shifts in slow bands over the sand.

images.caption: The people of Hawaii look up
images.alt: A Pacific-island village at night as everyone comes outside to look up: villagers of all ages in the lane between lit houses, heads tipped back, faces lit from above by a cosmic purple glow. High above, an enormous humpback whale passes over, her long fins glowing purple and scattered with starlight, with Anna — a girl with chocolate-brown skin and long black hair in a floral sundress — a tiny figure standing on one fin. The sea beyond moves gently under the glow.
